setup.location: Add your clinic and its opening hours
setup.practitioner: Add your dentists and their hours

guide.locationNameText: The name patients see on your website and in their booking confirmations.
guide.locationAddressText: Choose the country and city, then the street. Patients find you by this address, and it puts your clinic on the map.
guide.locationHoursText: Add the days and hours you're open. Online booking only offers times inside them.
guide.serviceNameText: Use the words patients search for, such as “Teeth whitening”.
guide.serviceCategoryText: Groups the treatment on your website and in the portal's dentist search.
guide.serviceDurationText: How long it takes. Online booking keeps this much time free in the dentist's calendar.
guide.servicePriceText: Show a fixed price, a starting price, or “on request”.
guide.servicePublicText: Leave this on to show the treatment on your website and on the portal.
guide.practitionerNameText: As patients will see it when they book.
guide.practitionerServicesText: The treatments this dentist does. Patients can book only these with them.
guide.practitionerHoursText: Their weekly hours. Online booking offers times inside them.
guide.practitionerBookableText: Turn this on so patients can book this dentist from your website.

tour.day: Today's appointments for every dentist, in one place. A good page to start your day.
tour.appointments: Every booking, from your website, the portal or added by your team. Confirm, move or cancel them here.
tour.inquiries: Patients asking for a quote through the portal. Answer with a quote to win them.
tour.patients: Each patient's file: visits, treatment plans and notes.
